title: Fix unauthorized error when saving homestays

requirements.text: Remove or relax the admin-only authorization guard on the 'addHomeStay' (or equivalent) backend function so that authenticated users (including partners and non-admin authenticated principals) can successfully create and save homestay listings without receiving an 'Unauthorized: Only authenticated admins can add homestays' error.

quotes: Failed to save homestay: Unauthorized: Only authenticated admins can add homestays

acceptanceCriteria: An authenticated non-admin user can call the addHomeStay backend function without receiving an Unauthorized error.
The backend accepts and persists the homestay data submitted by authenticated users.
Admin users retain the ability to add homestays as before.
Unauthenticated (anonymous) callers still receive an appropriate error and cannot add homestays.

requirements.text: Update the HomeStayManagement frontend component to remove any client-side admin-only guard or error handling that blocks non-admin authenticated users from submitting the add-homestay form, ensuring the form submission reaches the backend for all authenticated users.

quotes: Failed to save homestay: Unauthorized: Only authenticated admins can add homestays

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Add Homestay' form is submittable by any authenticated user without a client-side authorization block.
On successful save, a success message is shown and the new homestay appears in the listing.
On failure (e.g. network error), a descriptive error message is shown without referencing 'admin only'.

constraints: Do not break existing admin capabilities — admins must still be able to add, edit, and delete homestays.
Do not allow unauthenticated (anonymous) principals to add or modify homestays.
This is a commercial application — changes must be stable, tested, and production-ready.
nonGoals: Adding new user roles or a full role-based access control overhaul.
Changes to booking, hotel, or room management authorization logic.
UI redesign or feature additions unrelated to the authorization fix.
